senses.gloss: m. (preced.) narrow point, peak, precipice, esp. Tsoḳ, the mountain from which the scapegoat was precipitated.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 67b:6">Ib. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>ומניין שבצ׳</he> and whence is it proved that the scapegoat must be led to a precipitous place?; a. e.—Pl. <he>צוֹקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:10">B. Mets. VII, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 36b:10">ib. 36ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
